name: В двух шагах от счастья
overview: Lara and Maks have their three-year wedding anniversary; in the midst of the celebration, it turns out that Lara is in love with her colleague and is going to file for divorce. Maks is crushed by this news. The compassionate mother-in-law takes matters into her own hands and decides to find him a new girlfriend so that he can forget her daughter and start building a relationship again. Rita, the daughter of her best friend, who is dating a married man, is the best candidate for this.
